test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Point A is 35 m to the north of Point B. Point C is 28 m to the west of Point B. Point D is 25 m to the south of Point C. Point E is 14 m to the west of Point D. Point F is 40 m to the north of Point E. In which direction is Point B with respect to Point F?
solution:
Given: 

Point A is 35 m to the north of Point B.

Point C is 28 m to the west of Point B.

Point D is 25 m to the south of Point C.

Point E is 14 m to the west of Point D.

Point F is 40 m to the north of Point E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0735fc12c8fd7ba95347b5e131442ef163d82f41910a9264fd4825b0cfa9f871.png] 

So, **Point B is 'South-East' of Point F**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
